content: Nehnepeseng en Luhwen Sahpw
Mwurin ar kalowehdier saphwo, mehn Israel ko koaros ahpw pokonpene Sailo oh kauwada Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale.
Mie kadaudok isuh en mehn Israel ko me saikinte ale sapwarail.
Sosua eri mahsanihong mehn Israel ko, “Ia werein amwail pahn awiawi mwohn amwail pahn kohwei oh ale sahpw me KAUN-O, Koht en amwail pahpa kahlap ako ketikihongkumwailehr?
Kumwail pilada ohl silimen sang ni ehuehu kadaudok. I pahn kadarihrwohng nan sahpwo pwe re en kilelehdi wasa me re men sapweniki. Mwuhr re pahn pwurodo rehi.
Sahpw en pahn pwalpeseng nanpwungarail wiahda peliensapw isuh: Suda pahn mihmihte nan sapwe ni palieir, oh Sosep nan sapwe ni paliepeng.
Kumwail eri ntingihedi mwomwen peliensapw isuho oh wadohng ie. I ahpw pahn wia usuhs
pwe I en rapahki kupwur en KAUN-O, atail Koht, ihs me pahn sapweniki ehuehu peliensapw.

Mehn Lipai kan sohte pahn iang ale sahpw duwehte kumwail, pwe pwaisarail iei wia samworo en KAUN-O. A kadaudok en Kad, Reupen oh Palimesehn Manase aleier pwaisarail ni palimesehn Sordan, me Moses, ladun KAUN-O patohwanohngirailehr.

Ohl ako eri patohla pwe re en koasoanehdi nan map sahpwo mwurin Sosua eh wiahiong irail kehkehlik pwukat: “Kumwail kohwei nan sahpw en pwon oh kilelehdi nan map wasa kan, kumwail ahpw pwurodo rehi. I pahn wia usuhs wasaht nan Sailo pwe I en rapahki kupwur en KAUN-O ong ni sahpw me ehuehu kadaudok pahn sapweniki.
Ohl ako eri patohla nan sahpwo pwon oh kilelehdi nan doaropwe duwen ar pwalangpeseng wiahkihda pelien sapw isuh, iangahki ar kahnimw kan. Irail eri pwurodo rehn Sosua nan Sailo.
Sosua eri wia usuhs pwehn rapahki kupwur en KAUN-O ong ni sahpw me ehuehu kadaudok pahn sapweniki, e ahpw kilelehiong ehuehu kadaudok en Israel ko wasa kei nan sahpwo.
Sahpw me Kohieng Pensamin
Keieun usuhs en peliensapw inenehdi peneinei kan en kadaudok en Pensamin. Sapwarailo mihte nanpwungen kadaudok en Suda oh Sosep.
Ni paliepeng irepen sapwarailo tepisang Sordan e ahpw tang kohdala paliepeng en Seriko oh palikapi daulih sahpw nahnahn lellahng ni sapwtehn en Pedapen.
Irepen sahpwo ahpw tang kohdihla palieir en Lus (me pil kin adaneki Pedel) ahpw kohdihla lel Atarod Addar, pohn nahna ni palieir en Pali Pahn Ped Oron.
Irepen sahpwo ahpw pil wetlahng palieir sang ni palikapi en nahna wet kolahng Kiriad Paal (de Kiriad Searim), me uhdahn sapwen kadaudok en Suda. Ih met irepen palikapi.
Irepen palieir tepsang ni keilen Kiriad Searim oh tang kolahng Pwarer kan en Neptoa.
E ahpw kohdihla lel ni tepin nahna me sallahng Wahun Innom me mi ni paliepeng en Wahun Repaim. E ahpw tang palieir kotehla Wahun Innom, palieir en nahna en mehn Sepus kan, oh kolahng Enrokel.
E Ahpw wetlahng paliepeng kolahng Ensemes ahpw uhd kohla Kelilod, me salehngete Wasahn Kot en Adummim. Irepen sahpwo ahpw pil tang kohdilahng Takain Pohan (Pohan iei nein Reupen)
oh daulih paliepeng en nahna me sallahng Wahun Sordan. E ahpw kohdihla nan wahuo,
ahpw tang daulih paliepeng en nahna en Ped Okla, oh ididi ni paliepeng en Sehden Mehla, wasa me Pillap Sordan kin kusla ie. Ih met irepen palieir.
Sordan me wia irepen palimese. Ih met irepen sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Pensamin.
Kahnimw kan me en peneinei kan en kadaudok en Pensamin iei Seriko, Ped Okla, Emek Kesis,
Ped Arapa, Semaraim, Pedel,
Appim, Para, Opra,
Keparammoni, Opni, oh Kepa: koaros patpene me eisek riau, iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene.
Pil mie kahnimw kei iei Kipeon, Rama, Peerod,
Mispa, Kepihra, Mosa,
Rekem, Irpeel, Tarala,

Sela, Aelep, Sepus (de Serusalem), Kipea, oh Kiriad Searim: koaros patpene me eisek pahieu, iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene. Ih sahpw wet me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Pensamin.
